title: The Three's Blessing
description: We ran out of moonpetal and spring water during the blight scare, and every blessing since has been made without them. I have tolerated that and I dislike it. Fill the stores from the blessed sites.

objectives.description: Gather Moonpetal flowers from the shrine grove
Fill a vial with water from the sacred spring
Return the ingredients to Priestess of Gaela

notes: Threat: modest but concrete - the temple ran dry of blessing ingredients once already, during the blight scare, and has been improvising since. Giver motive: Elara wants the stores full before the next emergency, not restocked for its own sake. Consequence: not wired.
